_comment: NYSE published calendar, maintained as DATA. NYSE Group releases the holiday + early-closings calendar THREE YEARS AT A TIME (2026-2028 released 2025-12-23; expect the 2027-2029 release around Dec 2026). Full closures (kind 0) and half days (kind 1, 13:00 ET close, after-hours 13:00-17:00). On each NYSE release: update this file, then `anchor run init-calendar` (queues both parts; activates at the next bell). Sources: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars + ICE IR press releases.
